order: roadmap order (docs/roadmap.md); a milestone may be complete only if every earlier one is

milestones.name: Freeze and audit the baseline
milestones.command: cargo run -p zerolm-policy --bin zerolm-baseline -- generate && cargo run -p zerolm-policy --bin zerolm-baseline -- check

milestones.name: Neural compute engine and architecture bake-off
milestones.command: cargo test --workspace && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-bakeoff -- --check model/specs/architecture.json

milestones.name: Bootstrap language interface and deterministic initialization
milestones.command: cargo test -p zerolm-tokenizer -p zerolm-engine -p zerolm-runtime -p zerolm-policy

milestones.name: First true online neural language model
milestones.command: cargo test -p zerolm-learning -p zerolm-eval && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-online-lm

milestones.name: Weight-resident associative memory
milestones.command: cargo test -p zerolm-memory -p zerolm-runtime && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-memory

milestones.name: Concepts, relations, and compositional reasoning
milestones.command: cargo test -p zerolm-engine -p zerolm-reasoner && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-reasoning

milestones.name: Uniform neural engine and WSP compiler
Real-text exposure streams and reference baselines
Representation-learning feasibility on real text (Gate A, decision gate)
Scalable core with compiled seed circuits and the selected learning rule (Gate B)
Reading into memory and reasoning inside the network
